paragraphs: Location (separate requests are required if traffic disruptions are anticipated in several locations) ____________________________________________________________________________________
Does this application require street cut or excavation? _______________________________________
Excavation fee: $50.00 per cut with $4.00 a linear foot
Notification of businesses and residents in area of closure is required no less than seven days in advance.
Applicant is responsible for restoration of the right-of-way according to specifications established by the Village of Elmwood Place.
Street closings must have detour signs located around closure. All signage must meet ODOT, Hamilton County, and Elmwood Place standards.
Village office staff will circulate this application to the Police, Fire, and Public Works Departments.  The permit will not be issued without the approval of each department.
